prospects.thesis: SMCI is the leading AI server/liquid-cooling rack integrator, directly monetizing hyperscaler capex through Blackwell-based systems shipping in volume this fall. At just 0.7x sales with a $26.7B cap, valuation has meaningfully compressed while options flow and institutional positioning have turned bullish, suggesting smart money is accumulating ahead of a re-rating. With auditor issues resolved and 10-K risk behind it, the setup favors a catch-up rally as AI infrastructure demand remains structurally strong.

GitLab's Duo AI-assisted DevSecOps platform is gaining enterprise traction as software teams consolidate onto unified pipelines with embedded AI code generation and security. The +22.8% 1M move reflects strong post-earnings momentum on accelerating Duo Enterprise attach rates, and bullish institutional flow signals conviction that FY27 guidance has room to move higher. At 7.9x sales for a durable ~25% grower with expanding margins, it's a reasonably-priced pure-play AI software beneficiary.

AMD's MI350 ramp and MI400 roadmap position it as the credible #2 AI accelerator vendor, with hyperscaler diversification away from single-source Nvidia dependency accelerating. Bullish options and institutional signals combined with +8.3% 1M momentum suggest the market is pricing in a stronger 2H26 data center GPU trajectory. Falling yields (10Y -6bps) support the high-multiple (21.7x P/S) growth complex, making this an attractive semi-AI diversifier alongside SMCI's hardware angle.

LMT's -9.8% 1M drawdown creates a compelling entry into the prime defense contractor most levered to Golden Dome missile defense, F-35 sustainment, and hypersonics programs — all FY27 budget priorities. Bullish options flow and institutional buying into weakness suggest professionals view the selloff as overdone relative to record $166B backlog. At 1.6x sales with a ~3% dividend yield, LMT offers defensive ballast plus a re-rating catalyst as budget clarity emerges.

BAH is a pure-play federal AI/cyber services provider benefiting from DoD's shift toward software-defined defense and JWCC cloud task orders. Bullish options positioning and +5.2% 1M performance signal recovery from earlier DOGE-related civilian contract fears, though bearish institutional flow warrants caution. Provides differentiated services exposure vs. LMT's hardware angle, but wait for confirmation before sizing up.
